phase_descriptions.cold_after_chunk_update: Retrieval after a no-op chunk embedding_text SQL update; the write is excluded and invalidates lexical content generation.
phase_descriptions.warm_repeat: Immediate repeat of the exact same query without a write.
phase_descriptions.after_unrelated_table_update: Retrieval after changing a scalar value in an unrelated marker table; the write is excluded.
phase_descriptions.after_relationship_upsert: Retrieval after an idempotent relationship upsert preserving endpoints, kind and weight; the write is excluded. Actual relationship content edits are covered by correctness tests, not this timing fixture.

reproduction: Copy examples/benchmark_rag_churn.rs unchanged into each compared source tree.
Build each with cargo build --release --locked --offline --example benchmark_rag_churn; retain both executable files.
Run each executable with arguments 64 16 128 20 /private/tmp/canonical-results.json in alternating baseline/current process order.
Compare canonical result files byte-for-byte; aggregate the emitted samples using index ceil((n - 1) * percentile).
measurement_scope: Candidate retrieval, hybrid rank fusion and final MMR/context selection only. max_hops=0 isolates lexical cache behavior and unchanged ranking; this does not measure or attribute improvements to the new query-aware graph beam.
limitations: One synthetic in-memory workload on one machine; not a general throughput or RAG quality claim.
Excludes fixture ingestion, invalidation writes, relationship writes, providers, network, HTTP handling and JSON result serialization.
No graph expansion, concurrent clients or GPU execution; no persistent WAL/checkpoint costs.
The main agent paused builds/tests during timing, but the operating system was not isolated or pinned and background desktop activity was not controlled.
Three paired processes with fixed phase order per query; later phases benefit from normal hot CPU/data caches.
The baseline is a pre-change working-tree snapshot, not a separately released version; rerunning this historical comparison requires preserving that snapshot or matching its recorded source hashes.
